subject: Streaming starvation during demo — urgent C-suite escalation
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@medilink.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, ops@medilink.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: Demo streaming: model output stalled after 3 tokens

Vanessa / team,

We just experienced a critical failure during a live investor demo. At ~09:09 PST the chat stream began returning 1–3 tokens and then paused for 20–40s repeatedly; at one point the socket closed with a 502 from the proxy. The demo slide deck and investor Q&A were disrupted — they were visibly unimpressed.

Attached are the client-side logs and a short screen recording (we redacted customer data). The requests look like normal size but the token emission rate dropped to near zero (we counted three tokens, then nothing). Our ops contact Jordan is looped in (copied).

Urgent ask: can you confirm whether this is a transient client-side glitch or something on Redwood's side? We need an immediate statement for investors and a follow-up plan.

Thanks,
Anna Lopez
Head of Product, MediLink Health

Attachments: medilink-demo-logs-20260615.txt, screenshot-connection-timeline.png

Anna —

I'm really sorry this happened during your investor session. We're pulling an incident channel now and David (engineering lead) is on triage. Initial ask: can you confirm whether the sample requests were against the hosted Redwood API (vs any private deployment)? We'll prioritize either way.

Immediate actions we are taking (I'll update in the channel):
- David's team will collect server-side traces and proxy logs for 09:00–09:20 PST.
- We'll enable a temporary routing fallback to a smaller, lower-latency model variant for any new streams from your account.
- Offer to provide a post-mortem and credit for the demo disruption — we'll propose numbers to our execs once we have impact metrics.

We will treat this as an urgent escalation and get back within 4 hours with a root-cause hypothesis.

—Vanessa

Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 12:45:08 -07:00
Subject: RE: Demo streaming: model output stalled after 3 tokens — initial triage

Team / Anna,

Initial engineering triage summary (09:00–09:30 PST window):
- We observed a sharp spike in proxy error rates (502/504) between 09:08:50 and 09:11:10. Error rate peaked at ~18% for live-streaming endpoints serving MediLink.
- Downstream inference hosts showed no GPU OOMs and model kernels executed normally; however token emission was delayed by repeated retry and backpressure cycles in the proxy layer.
- Throughput to the account dropped ~60% for streaming sessions; concurrent connections briefly exceeded the proxy scaling threshold leading to repeated socket resets.
- WebSocket keepalive probes show RTT increases and several connections timed out after the chunked transfer stalled.

Attachments: medilink-demo-logs-20260615.txt (server traces). Highlights in the logs: proxy thread pool starvation for ~20s, followed by an automated scale-up that recovered throughput at 09:13:40. I put key timestamps and stack traces in the attachment.

Proposed immediate mitigations (we can implement within minutes):
1) Route MediLink traffic to the warm pool in us-west-2 (short term route override).
2) Fall back to model-compact-v1 for new streams to reduce per-token latency and avoid large KV cache operations.
3) Enable aggressive keepalive and reduce proxy idle window for this tenant for 24 hours.

Recommended customer communications: apologize, note we observed a proxy scaling anomaly, explain mitigations taken, propose a credit equal to two production-days of streaming usage, and offer a joint post-mortem within 48 hours.

Requesting exec sign-off for the credit and SLA exception (see suggested language below).

--David Kim
Engineering Lead — Serving Runtime

Subject: Exec ask: approval for credit & SLA exception for MediLink demo outage

Markus / Evelyn —

Summary: MediLink Health experienced a high-impact streaming degradation during an investor demo at ~09:09 PST that produced near-zero token emission and repeated socket resets for ~15–25 minutes. Customer impact: investor demo interrupted; customer has asked for a written statement and a remediation plan. We have validated the cause as a proxy scaling anomaly that produced transient thread-pool starvation and WebSocket timeouts.

Impact metrics:
- Peak proxy error rate: ~18% between 09:08:50–09:11:10 PST
- Throughput drop: ~60% for active streaming sessions during the window
- Affected sessions: 3 concurrent demo sessions (one investor-facing)

Actions taken:
- Mapped timeline and uploaded server traces (attached).
- Implemented routing override to warm pool and temporary fallback to model-compact-v1.
- Customer-facing comms drafted and ready to send once we have credit approval.

Request: approval for the following (aiming to send to MediLink by EOD PT):
1) Credit: two production days of streaming usage (est. credit = $4,800).
2) SLA exception: waive the 30-day notice on routing overrides and allow temporary connection parameter changes for 48 hours.
3) Exec-owned line: a short apology from Redwood leadership (suggested: Markus).

If you approve, we'll send the draft comms and the post-mortem invite for 48 hours out. If you want a smaller/larger credit, call out the amount and we'll adjust the message.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
